text:
noah_ops: Need a 30m console unlock for kv-store to reproduce a customer issue. Will only pull sample keys and logs. ticket: INC-4721

maria_s: What's the minimum access? can you do read-only? :thinking:

noah_ops: Needs sudo on redis-prod-1 to run keyscan + dump. I'll redact values and limit to 50 keys. No exports of full datasets.

tim_dev: please add the justification in the short-lived access form: https://redwood.internal/security/priv-request (helps auditors)

noah_ops: added link and comment to the ticket: https://redwood.internal/jira/INC-4721#comment-5

sec_bot: policy-check: short-lived console unlock requires start/end times, an explicit approver, and the exact list of commands to be run. Ensure logs uploaded to the ticket. Creating temp-role request...

sec_bot: temp-role request id tr-98431 created; pending human approver.

maria_s: I approve for 45m starting now. Monitor and revoke when done. :white_check_mark:

olivia_prod: i'll stand by as secondary approver; notify on-call if anything unexpected.

noah_ops: starting now 2024-10-12T14:05Z. Commands I will run:
```
redis-cli -h redis-prod-1 --scan | head -n 50 > /tmp/keys.txt
redis-cli -h redis-prod-1 --rdb /tmp/dump.rdb
```

noah_ops: I'll redact values before any upload using: `sed -E 's/("value":").+(")/\1REDACTED\2/'` and verify counts only.

sec_bot: reminder: use KMS-wrapped transfer and attach SHA256 of files to the ticket. Mark temp-role expiry in the request. :lock:

noah_ops: dump completed, redaction script applied, uploaded redacted dump to INC-4721 (attachment tr-98431). revoking role now.

maria_s: saw the upload, looks good. thanks for keeping it minimal. closing loop. :thumbsup:

noah_ops: thanks everyone, closing out on my side as well.
